notes.title: Update Note 20201022
notes.content:
1. Fixed the bug that may cause the game to be unresponsive when launched. 
2. Fixed some text errors. 
3. Fixed the bug that may cause DLC content not to be touch controlled in macOS.

notes.title: Patch Note: Gameplay Optimization
notes.content:
1. Optimized the storyline flowchart and the fast forward experience. Fixed some bugs regarding jumping to certain points of the game. 
2. Corrected some errors in the text. 
Thank you all for the feedback!

notes.title: Fix and update notice: About some achievements that cannot be achieved
notes.content:
First of all, We apologize to everyone who supports us!
Due to our mistakes, some of the achievements could not be achieved correctly. For this, we have carried out a game update. After the update, you may need to pass the corresponding ending again to get these achievements!
Again, we apologize for causing trouble to everyone! Thanks for your support!
